title: Grilled Sea Bass Skewers
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired dish featuring grilled sea bass skewers. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and sugar. Add sliced ginger and stir to combine.
Thread sea bass fillets onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush skewers with soy sauce mixture and sprinkle with chopped green onions.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Serve immediately and garnish with additional green onions if desired.
